g.text: One sublayer seam under mHC (n = 4), and the single-pass shift
per seam: streams read for coefficients,
read again for A X_l once A is known
(A depends on a reduction over all of X_l)
Single-pass mHC: use last seam's A
Mega-mHC: residual update, input mixing, coefficient prediction, pre-norm, FP8 cast in one tiled kernel: streams read once, written once.
Traffic per seam (in units of d): (4n+4)d = 20d for three kernels + norm; (3n+2)d = 14d two-pass; (2n+2)d = 10d single-pass. 80 seams per token.
